2116848864288244223.en_summary: (Reposted by @robin_j_brooks) Brent +10% maps to gold −4% and silver −8%, on Brooks's numbers from the second half of October. I think this is a hot-war liquidity trade, not a rates trade. US real 10y yields fell about 30bp in October while Brent rose 13.6%, and that should have helped gold. Two weeks of daily data is a short window, so I'd treat the link as fragile if Hormuz reopens.
2116848864288244223.zh_summary: （由@robin_j_brooks轉推）布倫特油價+10%對應黃金−4%及白銀−8%，根據Brooks 10月下半月的數字。我認為這是熱戰流動性交易，而非利率交易。美國實際10年債息在10月下降約30個基點，而布倫特上升13.6%，這本應有助黃金。兩周的每日數據是短窗口，所以如果霍爾木茲重新開放，我會把這個關聯視為脆弱。
